name: chopchop
description: chopchop: cut big features into small, one-repo tasks and build each one end to end, using the tools your team already has. Learn the system, bring in an epic's stories, write a design a lead can approve (with a high-level design, a main flow, choices, slides and a review message), turn it into a full spec with code that fits each repo, cut tasks from the spec with a board, code one task to an open PR, and track every test to done.
